scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Solar Rooftop Capital Incentive Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must have an electricity connection
Individual homes/flats are eligible for a 1 kW solar system; residential flats can apply for 5 kW, 10 kW or multiples as group applications
Vendor/Installer must be a qualified solar installer empanelled by the Tamil Nadu Energy Development Agency
benefits_summary: Provides a capital subsidy of ₹20,000 per kilowatt for grid‑connected domestic solar PV systems, in addition to the existing 30% MNRE subsidy.
